body:
This modpack is a collection of my mods!
Koreans are very welcome!

# **🍝 Pasta's Modpack**

Pasta's Modpack is a lightweight **performance-focused modpack** for Minecraft Fabric 1.21.
It keeps the vanilla Minecraft experience while improving performance, visuals, and overall gameplay comfort.

If Minecraft feels laggy or slow on your computer, this modpack helps solve that problem.
With several optimization mods included,** the game runs smoother, faster, and more stable.**

At the same time, the modpack includes shader support and visual improvements that make the Minecraft world look more beautiful and immersive, while still keeping the classic vanilla feel.

If you want a fast, clean, and better-looking Minecraft experience, Pasta's Modpack is a great choice.

### 🚀 Performance Focused

This modpack is built mainly to improve performance and stability.

**⚡ Higher FPS**

**🚀 Faster loading times**

**💻 Playable even on lower-end PCs**

**🧩 Includes several Fabric optimization mods**




### 🌅 Better Visuals

Pasta's Modpack also improves how Minecraft looks.

**✨ Shader support**

**🌄 Better lighting and atmosphere**

**🌿 A more immersive Minecraft world**

**🎮 Vanilla+ Experience**

The goal of this modpack is to keep the vanilla style while improving the overall experience.

**🧭 Vanilla-friendly mods
🎒 Quality-of-life improvements
🎮 A smoother and more enjoyable Minecraft experience**


_Minecraft Version: 1.21.8
Mod Loader: Fabric_

⭐ Fast. Beautiful. Vanilla-friendly.
Enjoy Minecraft in a smoother and better way with Pasta's Modpack.


**_(I'm Korean. Please understand if my English is strange.)_**
